title: fix: close server on failed start (fix #23965)
body:
Now we close the server when `configureServer` throws, or `buildStart` throws in middleware mode. It goes through `server.close()` since the cloudflare plugin stops workerd from its close wrapper. This means `closeServer` hooks also run on a failed start, which I think is right since that's where plugins clean up.

Fixes #23965

title: WASM playground can lose clicks before async module initialization
body:
### Describe the bug

The WASM playground renders enabled buttons before its module finishes initializing. Direct WASM imports introduce top-level `await`, so `page.goto()` can finish while the module body has not yet registered the click listeners. title: feat: export default server.fs.deny patterns
body:
Closes #24015.

Export `defaultServerFsDeny` as a frozen `readonly string[]` so configurations can extend Vite's defaults without copying them. Keep explicit-list replacement, including `deny: []`, unchanged; resolved configurations receive independent mutable arrays. Includes documentation and runtime/type tests.
